dct_description_sm:
Footprints include what appear to be permanent structures, such as houses, sheds, garages, industrial/commercial buildings, etc. Mobile homes are included if they are situated in a location for a longer term, such as in a trailer park, but would not be included if they're present in a campground.

This dataset only includes footprints within the Town of Caledon.  Footprints are available for Brampton and Mississauga at their Open Data portals:

  • City of Brampton - Building Footprints
  • City of Mississauga - Building Roofs
